question: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1875**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in the year **1875**.
 
• The Arya Samaj was established in Bombay on **10th April 1875**.
 
• Swami Dayanand Saraswati was a prominent Hindu religious leader and a reformer of the Vedic dharma.
 
• The Arya Samaj promotes values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Dayanand Saraswati**

 
 
• Swami Dayanand Saraswati was born on 12th February 1824 in Gujarat, India.
 
• He was a staunch critic of idolatry and social evils that plagued Hindu society during his time.
 
• His most influential work is the book "Satyarth Prakash" (The Light of Truth).
 
• He propagated the idea of going back to the Vedas, which he considered as the true source of knowledge and guidance.
 
 
 
• **Arya Samaj**
 
 
• The Arya Samaj is a Hindu reform movement that promotes values and practices based on the belief in the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
• It opposes caste discrimination and promotes equal rights for women including education and widow remarriage.
 
• The motto of Arya Samaj is "Krinvanto Vishwam Aryam" which means "Make the world noble".
 
• The Arya Samaj has been involved in various social and educational reforms in India.
